verdict.rationale: Embeddings and reranking are a fair question for a hosted LLM inference API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents chat, streaming, structured outputs, tool calling, batch, vision inputs and caching, but nothing about an embeddings or rerank endpoint or model. OpenAI compatibility in general does not show that embeddings are offered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor
